name: AWS Glue
summary: An AWS Glue Python shell job or a Step Functions task calls Ogun's server bridge over HTTPS to start a run of an approved workflow and read its state. AWS calls Ogun; Ogun does not drive AWS.

fields.name: ogun_api_token
fields.label: Ogun API token
fields.help: A token a signed-in person creates; role editor to start runs. Sent as a Bearer header; keep it in AWS Secrets Manager, not in Ogun.

settings.name: server_url
settings.label: Ogun server URL
settings.help: The public_url of ogun-server: an origin with no path.

settings.name: workspace
settings.label: Workspace id
settings.help: Sent as x-ogun-workspace. A token belongs to one workspace, so this is rarely needed.

egress.note: AWS calls Ogun. Nothing leaves the machine from Ogun for this connector.

notes: AWS Glue calls Ogun and cannot approve. The job or task sends POST /api/v1/workflows/{name}/runs and polls GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id} (O-13 section 6.2). A run that needs an approval waits for a person on the Ogun CLI or in Studio. ogun-server was proven only against a fake ogund.
